resources.title: Enterprise Data Governance Architecture Infographic (1 of 4)
resources.description: The full enterprise data governance framework: strategy, policies, processes, people, technology, and measurement. Covers how data flows from source systems (SQL Server, Oracle, Salesforce, cloud apps, files/APIs) through ingest & integrate, store & model, govern & manage (catalog, rules, quality, security), to deliver & use — with Microsoft Purview as the governing layer. Includes the key governance roles (Data Owner, Data Steward, Data Custodian, Governance Council, Data Governance Engineer), a real "active customer" definition conflict resolved through governance, governance domains, and the 5-step governance lifecycle (assess, define, implement, monitor, improve).

resources.title: Data Catalog, Metadata & Lineage Infographic (2 of 4)
resources.description: How a Data Governance Engineer answers "where did this number come from, and can we trust it?" A real Meridian Financial Group example traces a $12.4M revenue figure from source systems (SQL Server, Salesforce, Oracle) through Azure Data Factory, an enterprise data warehouse, a Power BI semantic layer, to the final report — discover, trace, understand, verify, trust. Covers core concepts (data catalog, metadata, data lineage, business glossary, sensitivity classification), real metadata examples by type (business, technical, operational, governance), and the key tasks and tools (Microsoft Purview, Azure Data Factory) a governance engineer uses daily.

resources.title: Data Quality Engineering Infographic (3 of 4)
resources.description: The 5-step data quality lifecycle (profile, assess, fix, monitor, prevent) and the 6 data quality dimensions (accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, timeliness). Walks through a real before-and-after customer-data cleanup (50,000 records down to 42,500 high-quality records, with missing emails, duplicates, invalid phone numbers, and inactive records resolved), includes real sample SQL for finding and fixing quality issues, a data quality scorecard with baseline/after-cleanup/target values, example data quality rules, and best practices for building quality in rather than cleaning up after the fact.

resources.title: Data Security, Privacy & Compliance Infographic (4 of 4)
resources.description: How a Data Governance Engineer turns policy into technical controls: the classify-control-protect-monitor-comply framework, key security controls (RBAC, least privilege, encryption at rest/in transit, dynamic data masking, private endpoints, auditing), sensitive data categories (PII, financial, PHI, confidential/internal), a real marketing-data access-request scenario walked end to end, the major compliance frameworks (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, SOX, HIPAA, PCI DSS), and how it's all implemented in Microsoft Azure and Purview (classification, access/Entra ID, data protection, compliance & audit).
